notes_for_human: Verbatim, tier-1 detail came only from Duolingo's own blog post (blog.duolingo.com/duolingo-thrive-intern-program/), not the careers site itself, which is JS-blocked to both WebFetch and the Greenhouse content API. The blog states Thrive targets 'rising juniors' (i.e., current sophomores applying for the summer before junior year) and gives per-track opening windows (late Sept for SWE, Oct for PM, early Nov for Design/Studio Art) as a recurring annual pattern — it does NOT give year-specific 2027 dates, so I did not fabricate a 'Summer 2027 opens [date]' claim. Several aggregator sites (Extern, GeeksforGeeks, Opportunities for Youth) surfaced in search with more specific-sounding 2026/2027 dates and a '76% conversion rate' stat, but per your rules I did not quote or rely on them — none is Duolingo's own site. Sponsorship and reapplication/cooling-off policy are genuinely silent on the one page I could read; I could not confirm they're silent on the official Thrive careers page itself since that page never rendered. If precise 2027 dates matter, the next verification pass should retry careers.duolingo.com with a JS-capable browser tool (e.g., the Browser pane) rather than WebFetch, or watch boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/duolingo/jobs for new Thrive postings to appear around late September 2026.
